summary: Cheat sheet for the Ansible tone: active voice, present tense, address the reader, standard English, and American spelling, with good and bad examples.
questions: Should docs use active or passive voice?
Should I write 'will create' or 'creates' in docs?

answer_card.title: Ansible tone cheat sheet
answer_card.answer_md:
| Rule | Good | Bad |
|---|---|---|
| Active voice | You can run a task by | A task can be run by |
| Present tense | This command creates a | This command will create a |
| Address the reader | As you expand your inventory | When the number of managed nodes grows |
| Standard English | Return to this page | Hop back to this page |
| American English | color | colour |
